row.evidence: Marvel's help centre says "SAML SSO is available on our Enterprise plans" and that with SSO new people "can be automatically added to Marvel"; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the pricing page, help centre or API docs.
row.notes: New row (Marvel prototyping, marvelapp.com). Plans: Free $0, Pro $12/mo billed yearly (single user, skipped as team plan), Team $42/mo billed yearly starting at 3 users (about $14 per user, not stated as a per-user price, so the numeric field is null; extra team members are charged per user), Enterprise quote-only (7+ users) with SSO. Provisioning is SAML SSO with automatic account creation on sign-in (JIT); the help centre search API returns no results for 'scim' or 'provisioning'. Okta's OIN 'Marvelapp' app is SAML only; Marvel's own guides use custom SAML apps for Okta, OneLogin, Google and Azure, with metadata sent to a Customer Experience Manager. The GraphQL API can read company members and create teams but documents no user create, remove or deactivate.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: $42 / month billed yearly, starts at 3 users
plans.notes: Team members carry a per-user charge; $42 for the 3-user starting size works out to about $14 per user, which the page does not state.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Let's chat / Request a Quote (7 or more users)

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented. SSO setup guides describe SAML apps only and the help centre has no SCIM or provisioning articles.

user_api.notes: GraphQL API. User-related scopes cover reading company members and creating or modifying company teams; no documented mutation adds, removes or deactivates company members. Which plan unlocks company scopes is not stated beyond 'Pro, Team or Company account' for some features.

endpoints.purpose: Single GraphQL endpoint for all queries and mutations

okta.notes: OIN 'Marvelapp' page markup marks only SAML as checked (last updated May 17 2018). Marvel's own guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Marvel lists Microsoft Azure SSO; no Entra gallery tutorial found.

google.notes: Custom Google SAML app per Marvel's guide.

onelogin.notes: Marvel's guide uses OneLogin's generic SAML Test Connector.
